reviews.title: Think before You Subscribe
reviews.text:
I’m very disappointed with Turbo VPN’s subscription and refund process.

I purchased my subscription directly from the Turbo VPN website. The service had become difficult and ineffective for me to use in Myanmar, so I had already stopped relying on it and switched to another VPN.

My subscription was automatically renewed for $59.99, and I contacted Turbo VPN on the same day as the renewal charge to cancel the subscription, disable auto-renewal, and request a refund.

Support repeatedly gave me the same response that auto-renewed subscriptions are not refundable. I pointed out that Section 6.5 of their own Terms of Service refers to cancellations made “after the day of charge”, while I contacted them on the day of the charge.

I then tried to resolve the issue through live chat. On two separate occasions, the support agents disconnected the chat before my request was resolved or properly escalated to a supervisor.

My main concern is not only the VPN’s performance, but the customer experience around auto-renewal, cancellation, refunds, and support. Cancelling a website subscription should be straightforward, and customers should be able to get a clear answer instead of being disconnected when they ask for escalation.

I would recommend that anyone considering Turbo VPN carefully review the renewal and refund terms and make sure they understand the cancellation process before subscribing.

reviews.title: Turbo VPN has declined from its once great performance
reviews.text:
I’m giving 3 stars instead of 1 because the app was great before, but recent updates have made it frustrating and less reliable. Turbo VPN used to connect directly from the control center and provide uninterrupted access all day. Now, you can’t connect from the control center or settings; every time, you have to open the app and manually tap to connect.

The app is overloaded with ads, many of which are misleading and intrusive. Sometimes it even fails to open the required pages in the browser, making extended browsing difficult. While it still works, it’s far from the smooth experience it once offered

Updated on Nov 13, 2025:
After subscribing to the premium version, my experience unfortunately declined. When connecting through the Indian server, Indian websites failed to load and the connection speed was extremely slow. I reached out to live chat support; they requested the website link and suggested changing the protocol. However, when I returned to apply the change, the chat session had already closed. Overall, this has been a disappointing experience, and I regret upgrading to the paid plan.
